IJ_reference.note: Razzouk 2023 (supine CT, abstract level): sternal notch at the T2-T3 vertebral bodies; skin IJ is used as given in the c004 record

reading: delta = rebuilt body centre minus c004 stick midpoint; c004 sticks include the disc space, so c004 body centres are not definition-identical to the rebuilt ones (expected few-mm offsets even for a perfect column).
Rib heads articulate with thoracic bodies: a thoracic shift moves the costovertebral joints by about the same amount.
